**Content Policy Workarounds**: Google acknowledged overly cautious filters. Best practices include hyper-specific prompts with commercial context, declaring art style explicitly, and using "fictional character" language for human figures.

**Fashion Photography**: Excels at flat-lay product shots and e-commerce photography. Template-based prompts with photographic language (lighting, lens, angle) produce best results. Costs only $0.039/image.

**Virtual Try-On**: Supports up to 5 reference images for character consistency, but identity is NOT locked - features can drift. Use high-res references (1024×1024+) and explicit preservation instructions.

**Limitations**: Complex typography requires iteration, character consistency can drift, aspect ratios may need explicit control, safety filters can over-trigger. Workarounds involve conversational refinement and positive reframing.

**Negative Prompts**: NO traditional negative prompt support. Instead use "semantic positive reframing" - describe the desired scene positively rather than what to avoid.

**OpenRouter Integration**: Standard `/api/v1/chat/completions` endpoint with `image_config` for aspect ratio (10 options) and size (1K/2K/4K). Images return as base64 data URLs.

All findings include actionable templates, real-world examples, and comprehensive source links.</result>
